description: This file defines a static class `FontDescriptorCache` within the `PdfSharp.Fonts` namespace, responsible for managing a global cache of font descriptor objects, primarily for OpenType fonts. It provides methods to retrieve or create font descriptors based on various inputs such as `XFont`, `XGlyphTypeface`, or font family names with styles. The cache is synchronized with locks and interacts with global cache storage. It also includes a partial class that extends internal global storage related to font descriptors.

classes.name: FontDescriptorCache
classes.description: A static class providing caching mechanisms for font descriptors, optimized for performance and memory reuse.

methods.name: GetOrCreateDescriptorFor
methods.description: Retrieves an existing `FontDescriptor` for a given `XFont`, or creates and caches a new one if not present.

methods.name: GetOrCreateDescriptorFor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a `FontDescriptor` for a given `XGlyphTypeface`.

methods.name: GetOrCreateDescriptor
methods.description: Obtains a `FontDescriptor` based on font family name and style, creating and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears all entries in the font descriptor cache.
